with_memory.headline: Claim appears typical with no strong fraud indicators
with_memory.reasoning: The claim shares only weak connections such as the same garage and similar rear‑end narratives, but no personal identifiers (phone, bank account, vehicle) link to prior fraud. One weak link to a confirmed‑fraud claim exists, yet it is not a strong signal. Historical patterns show many similar claims approved, providing mitigating context.

red_flags.title: Shared garage with a fraud claim
red_flags.detail: The garage Sri Balaji Auto Works was involved in a confirmed‑fraud claim (CLM-2026-10595).

mitigating_factors: No phone, bank account or vehicle overlap with past fraudulent claims
Majority of similar past claims were approved
Intermediary and surveyor have handled genuine claims before
next_steps: Obtain and review the photos taken at the scene
Confirm the absence of a police report and request a written statement if possible
Validate the garage estimate against market rates
questions_for_claimant: Can you provide the photos you took at the accident site?
Do you have any written communication from the other driver or their insurance?
Why was a police report not filed for this rear‑end collision?
